scripts.build: npm run check:api && vue-tsc -b && vite build
scripts.generate:api: uv run python ../scripts/export_builder_openapi.py && openapi-typescript src/api/openapi.json -o src/api/schema.d.ts --alphabetize
scripts.check:api: uv run python ../scripts/export_builder_openapi.py --check && openapi-typescript src/api/openapi.json -o src/api/schema.d.ts --alphabetize --check
